faqs.q: How do I know if my roof needs a complete replacement or a simple repair?
faqs.a: If shingles are curling, missing across large sections, or older than 20 years, replacement is typically more economical than patch repairs. We provide a photographic inspection showing exact roof conditions so you can make an informed choice.

faqs.q: Can you help with insurance storm damage claims?
faqs.a: Yes. We document hail fractures and wind uplift with high-resolution imagery and meet your insurance adjuster on-site to ensure all storm damage is accurately represented.

faqs.q: How long does a standard residential roof replacement take?
faqs.a: Most residential re-roofing projects are completed in 1 to 2 days, including full tear-off, underlayment installation, shingle application, and magnetic nail sweep.

faqs.q: Do you serve all neighborhoods in Dallas?
faqs.a: Yes, we provide full roofing, gutter, and repair services across all residential and commercial zones in Dallas and surrounding communities.
